en.text: "By the way, you said you went to get your driver's license, right? Did you pass?" "Yeah, I did. I failed it three times, but somehow I got it this time."

original: 好きと嫌いは紙一重って言うけど、嫌いなものは嫌い。

en.text: They say there's only a paper-thin difference between love and hate, but I hate what I hate.

original: 泳げるって言ってなかったっけ？

en.text: I thought that you said you could swim.

original: 純粋な幸せは偶然に見つかるって言ってた。

en.text: They say that true happiness is found accidentally.

original: ノックしてって言ったでしょ！

en.text: I told you to knock!

original: トムのやつ、断トツでゴールするって言ってた割には、最後の方バテバテで抜かされそうだったな。

en.text: Even though Tom said he would definitely score, by the end of the match he was so tired that he almost stopped playing.

original: トムは、自分は結婚してるって言ってた。

en.text: Tom said that he was married.

original: 彼は忙しくないって言った。

en.text: He says he isn't busy.

original: トムが僕に送ったって言ってた荷物、届かなかったんだ。

en.text: I never received the package that Tom said he sent me.
I never got the package that Tom said he'd sent me.

original: 離婚したいって言ってる？

en.text: Are you saying you want a divorce?

original: 私が嘘をついてるって言いたいわけ？

en.text: Are you saying I'm a liar?
